events.title: Meet the Author Kristin Koval
events.description: An Evening with “Penitence” Author Kristin Koval Join us for an evening with Colorado author Kristin Koval, former attorney and author of the award‑winning debut novel “Penitence. ” This literary thriller delves into the complexities of familial loyalty, the pursuit of redemption, and the transformative power of forgiveness. Don’t miss this insightful author talk and book signing.
